pages.text: There's another lich, and he's nothing to do with that forest.$(br2)He lives up in the cold, in a tower of his own. The undead out here sometimes drop a little star. Throw it and it flies toward the tower. Put four on the altars inside and he'll come.
$(o)Whispers say the Night Lich keeps the Evil Eye, in his tower out in the cold biomes.$()
